Great questions — below is a concise explanation of how Redwood handles quotas, bursts, and overage pricing. I've also included a ballpark pricing table (hosted) for your planning. See attached doc for full policy.

Quota & burst behavior- Default hosted quota: per-project token quota is provisioned based on expected monthly volume and concurrent throughput. For new accounts we typically start with a conservative quota and then provision burst credit.
- Burst headroom: short bursts (1-4 hours) up to ~2x your provisioned throughput can be allowed via temporary burst credits—these are pre-approved for launches when we're informed 48-72 hours ahead.
- Throttling: if you exceed both provisioned quota and any active burst credits, requests are throttled (429s). We avoid hard failures via two options: temporary auto-increase (subject to capacity) or fallback to a compatible lower-cost/low-latency model variant.
- Quota increase SLA: standard requests are processed in 24-72 hours; urgent launch requests (48+ hour notice) we can prioritize.

Overage pricing (hosted) — ballpark (subject to final quote):
- Base list price: $180 per 1M tokens.
- Volume discounts: 100M+ tokens/month -> $150 per 1M; 300M+ -> $120 per 1M.
- Overage rate (when you exceed a committed/reserved monthly quota): typically billed at 1.2x the effective unit rate for that month (so if you're on $150/1M, overage billed at $180/1M).
- Billing cadence: monthly; overages are charged with that month's invoice and broken out on the invoice line items.

Dedicated / Reserved capacity guidance
- If you need strict per-token unit economics and guaranteed throughput for bursts, reserved capacity with a monthly commit can be cheaper at scale and offers higher guaranteed burst throughput. We can model a quote that shows break-even by tokens/month.

Quick example (for planning):
- If Acme commits to 50M tokens at $150/1M -> $7,500/mo. If you use 60M and no reserved capacity, the extra 10M would be billed as overage at 1.2x -> $180/1M => $1,800 extra. Total ~$9,300 that month.

Proposed next steps
1) If Jared confirms the 60M/month + 12M/hr burst profile, I'll produce two side-by-side quotes: hosted (with temporary launch burst credit) and reserved (12-month commit options).
2) If you want, Rafael can run a quick capacity check to confirm we can support the 12M/hr burst for the expected launch window.

I'm attaching the rate-limits FAQ and a short pricing sketch. Happy to hop on a quick call later today.

Thanks — Marissa
